يبتعثون (form VIII)
# يَبْتَعِثُونَ (yabtaʕiṯūna) /jab.ta.ʕi.θuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
# يُبْتَعَثُونَ (yubtaʕaṯūna) /jub.ta.ʕa.θuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
